headline: 2026 FIFA World Cup Opens June 11 at Estadio Azteca
deck: Mexico City will host the opening ceremony and first match of the expanded 48-team tournament featuring 104 matches across three nations.
summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup kicks off on June 11, 2026, at Mexico City's Estadio Azteca with an opening ceremony beginning at 11:30 local time, 90 minutes before the first match. The tournament marks a historic expansion to 48 teams competing in 104 matches across 16 host cities in the United States, Mexico, and Canada, culminating in the final on July 19, 2026, at New York New Jersey Stadium. Top Latin music artists including J Balvin, Maná, and Alejandro Fernández will perform at the opening ceremony.
